sources.entry: claude-powerline by Owloops - A vim-style powerline statusline for Claude Code with real-time usage tracking, git integration, custom themes, and more.

summary.one_liner: A vim-style powerline statusline for Claude Code that shows real-time usage, cost, rate-limit windows, git status, and more, with themes and a configurable layout.
use_cases: see Claude Code token usage and cost while coding
monitor 5-hour and weekly rate limit utilization
show git branch and status in the Claude Code prompt area
customize a terminal statusline with themes and layouts
set daily or monthly budget warnings for Claude usage
display context window fill level during a session
notable: Interactive /powerline setup wizard writes config and updates settings.json
Segments for session, today, month, block, and weekly usage with budget thresholds
Grid-based TUI layout engine with breakpoints and per-cell tokens
Four separator styles (minimal, powerline, capsule, tui) and a text-only charset for terminals without Nerd Font
Six built-in color themes plus custom hex color themes
caveats: Block and weekly segments need Claude.ai Pro/Max native rate_limits data and are hidden otherwise
Unicode icons require a Nerd Font; use --charset=text otherwise
Claude Code may truncate long status lines, so autoWrap or multi-line layout is recommended
Cache timer only refreshes when Claude Code re-runs the statusline unless refreshInterval is set
